label: OBS: measurements only (pYIN f0 on the bass stem, 0.25 s windows); roots are pitch classes, not harmonic interpretation (INT)

method.dominant_pitch: RMS-weighted histogram of rounded MIDI notes among voiced frames; confidence = weight share of the winner x voiced-frame fraction
method.silence_rule: RMS more than 40 dB below file maximum or unvoiced: null (no claim)
method.octave_error_flag: likely if >=25% of weighted mass sits on the same pitch class in another octave, or median f0 <41 Hz or >200 Hz (pYIN octave slips and sub-bass tracks are common); an unflagged window is not proof of the right octave
method.segments: run-length of pitch class; a single-window blip between two equal neighbours is absorbed

kick_grid.note: OBS: beat period and phase from 40-120 Hz drums-stem onsets; anchor is a kick-aligned beat (the strongest onset), NOT a confirmed bar downbeat. Half/double-time ambiguity is possible.
